item.title: North Topsail Beach announces town manager resignation
item.description: The Board of Aldermen of the Town of North Topsail Beach announced today the resignation of Town Manager Alice Derian, concluding her tenure leading the town’s administrative operations effective June 1, 2026.

item.title: Armed man rammed vehicle into Michigan synagogue and was fatally shot by security, AP source says
item.description: A man armed with a rifle rammed a vehicle into the nation’s largest Reform synagogue, in a Detroit suburb, and was fatally shot by security, The Associated Press has learned.

item.title: 1 of 3 victims has died after a shooting at Virginia’s Old Dominion University, campus police say
item.description: A gunman is dead and two people are hurt after a shooting at Old Dominion University on Thursday morning, the Virginia school said.

item.title: CFCC to offer New Food Service Courses beginning in April
item.description: Cape Fear Community College will begin offering two new continuing education courses this April – Food Service 101 and ServSafe® Manager Certification.

item.title: Community reacts to fatal house fire in Brunswick County
item.description: Two children have died after a mobile home fire early Thursday morning in the City of Northwest.

item.title: ‘A good soul;’ Whiteville community mourns former teacher, fitness center owner after deadly assault
item.description: Many in the Whiteville community are grieving on Thursday after the tragic death of a prominent community member and former school teacher.

item.title: Wilmington International Airport now reopened after evacuation due to a bomb threat
